socialprofile-desc: Qalab bulsheed oo loogu talagalay MediaWiki
socialprofile-uploads-disabled: Astaanta soo gelinta sawirka waa naafo
apihelp-removeavatar-summary: Ka saar sawirka astaanta, kaaga ama haddii aad leedahay oggolaansho, kan isticmaale kale sidoo kale.
apihelp-removeavatar-param-reason: Sabab ikhtiyaari ah oo aad u sheegayso sababta aad uga saarayso sawirka astaanta ee isticmaale kale.
apihelp-removeavatar-param-user: Magaca isticmaalaha ee sawirka astaantiisa la saarayo.
apihelp-removeavatar-example-1: Ka saar sawirka astaanta isticmaalaha lagu magacaabo "Ashley"
apihelp-removeavatar-example-2: Ka saar sawirka astaanta isticmaalaha lagu magacaabo "Elektra" iyadoo sababta tirtiristu tahay "Ku xadgudub xuquuqda daabacaadda oo cad"
apierror-avatar-is-default: Sawirka astaanta isticmaalaha hore ayuu u yahay kii caadiga ahaa.
apihelp-uploadavatar-example-url: Soo geli sawirka laga helo https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/b/bc/Wiki.png sidii sawirkaaga astaanta.
apihelp-smpuserprivacy-summary: Qaybta API-ga ee lagu dejiyo muuqaalka ("qarsoodin") goob ka mid ah astaanta isticmaale
apihelp-smpuserprivacy-param-field_key: Furaha goobta bartilmaameedka, tusaale ahaan up_movies oo loogu talagalay goobta "Filimaan"
apihelp-smpuserprivacy-param-privacy: Qiimaha cusub ee qarsoodinnimada (mid ka mid ah kuwa soo socda: public, hidden, friends, foaf)
